high_level_description: The image depicts the interior of the London Stock Exchange, as indicated by the prominent logo and text on the screens. The setting is a modern, well-lit area with large digital screens displaying financial data. The screens show the FTSE 100 index closing at a record high for the first time since February 2023, as stated in the text overlay at the bottom of the image. The screens are arranged in a grid pattern, with the central screen displaying the London Stock Exchange logo, which features a coat of arms with two lions and a unicorn flanking a cross, along with the motto "DICTUM ME
